changeSet.comment: HARD gates: hold-out Sharpe, strategy Sharpe at least buy-and-hold, and the existing full-sample Sharpe gate raised from 0 to 1. Context is refdata only — not applied on a main push until prod-deploy is added.
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO REFDATA.PROMOTION_METRIC (NAME, DISPLAY_NAME, METRIC_KEY, DIRECTION, REQUIREMENT_TYPE, PRIORITY, THRESHOLD, DESCRIPTION, USER_ID, UPDATED_AT) VALUES ('oos_sharpe_gate', 'OOS Sharpe GT 0', 'OOS Sharpe Ratio', 'higher_is_better', 'HARD', 5, 0, 'Hold-out Sharpe must be at least zero. A result with no walk-forward block fails.', 'system', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), ('sharpe_excess_gate', 'Sharpe GTE buy-hold', 'Sharpe Excess', 'higher_is_better', 'HARD', 15, 0, 'Full-sample strategy Sharpe must be at least the buy-and-hold Sharpe.', 'system', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC');
